types.name: Fenrir::BlendMode
types.doc: How a material's pixels combine with what is behind them. It picks the render stage and whether depth is written (ADR-0024).

values.name: Opaque
values.doc: Drawn over what is behind, writing depth.

values.name: Masked
values.doc: Opaque, but a pixel whose alpha is below the material's `alphaCutoff` is discarded.

values.name: AlphaBlend
values.doc: Mixed with what is behind by its alpha, without writing depth.

values.name: Additive
values.doc: Added to what is behind, without writing depth.

types.name: Fenrir::Colour
types.doc: A colour as linear red, green, blue and alpha, each a float, usually in [0, 1] (ADR-0025). Debug draw, materials and lights take it, and the renderer packs it for vertices. Colours written as sRGB hex values, as colour pickers and art tools give them, are converted when made (FromSrgb). Default constructed, it is opaque white.

types.name: Fenrir::DefaultTexture
types.doc: Which of the renderer's 1x1 default textures a texture parameter binds when a material sets none.

types.name: Fenrir::Detail::AssetKind
types.doc: Each kind of asset the store holds, one slot table per kind.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptAssetHandle
types.doc: An asset handle of no stated kind, laid out as AssetHandle<T> is: C#'s AssetHandle<T>.ToNative() and FromNative(). Default is the empty handle.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: The slot in the store's table of the kind.

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: The slot's generation when the asset was made; zero only in the empty handle.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptAssetOwner
types.doc: Who an asset is loaded or added for. It lives until its last owner ends, or until it is unloaded; naming an owner twice is the same as naming it once.

values.name: Scene
values.doc: The active scene: the asset is released when that scene is destroyed.

values.name: App
values.doc: The app: the asset lives as long as the asset store.

types.name: Fenrir::ShaderParameterType
types.doc: The type of a material parameter: a `float` to `vec4` member of `MaterialParams`, or a texture.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptShaderParameter
types.doc: One material parameter of a shader, with its parameter default: FenrirAssets's ShaderParameter without its name, which `Shaders.GetParameter` writes to a span.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: A number parameter's default: one value per component, the rest zero. Unused for a texture.

fields.name: texture
fields.doc: A texture parameter's default. Unused for a number.
